messages.author: 41e884b265118925
messages.subject: Renjin Eclipse IDE
parts:
Hi

I've just completed an early version of a Rengin Eclipse based IDE its
design and features derive from the following design documentation
http://www.ibm.com/developerworks/opensource/tutorials/os-ecl-commplgin1/
forming the conventional IDE perspective, in addition there is a
document centric perspective comprising a WYSIWYM structured eitor
supporting Docbook, DITA and MathML  forming, reporting tool,
containing two elements: analyse and plot. The analyse element has a
method attribute used to specify any acquired or computed value from
the Rejin perspective. The graph element specifies what is to be
plotted, using Renjin perspective, the document being edited is then
bound to the data and code specified in the Renjin perspective. After
binding the views of analyse element displays the measured or computed
data, the plot element displays the graphs.

Views are provided to link to the R system and Renjin allowing the
submission of commands to both for comparison and validation. Work
continues on debuging, data acquisition, display and graphing
features. If anyone has any ideas as to required features particularly
in the debuging, data and graphing areas I would be grateful.

Regards

Tony Kennedy
